actors.name: CLI User
actors.evidence: The Slurm Pipes client handles environment packaging (on demand or via pre-deployed bundles), transfers scripts, triggers `sbatch` or session jobs, and streams logs/metrics back through Dagster Pipes [@dagsterpipes]. Custom launchers can be added by extending the `ComputeLauncher` base class.

actors.name: Developer experience benefits
actors.description: Configonly mobility: Toggle DAGSTERDEPLOYMENT to jump between local execution, staging Slurm, and production supercomputers—no code forks.
